name: @opensa/perfect-map-asi
description: Our own limit-adjuster .asi for real GTA:SA 1.0 US: lifts the int16 IplDef pool-index ceiling (+ the other unbounded placement structures) behind the ghost-barriers bug. Cross-compiled macOS→Win32 (MinGW-w64), tested under Wine.

scripts.build:asi: npm run gen && make clean && make APPLY=1
scripts.build:verify: npm run gen && make clean && make
scripts.build:debug: npm run gen && make clean && make APPLY=1 DEBUG=1
